cli.restore_warning:
WARNING: This will replace every Thulu table in the target database
    ({database}) and overwrite the data directory ({dir}).
cli.copying_data: copying the data directory from {from} (without logs/ and runs/)...
cli.secretbox_reminder: The archive does not hold OCTOPUS_SECRETBOX_KEY. Keep that key apart from it: without the key the credentials in the dump cannot be read back.

remote_pruned.one: pruned {count} offsite backup beyond the newest {keep}.
remote_pruned.other: pruned {count} offsite backups beyond the newest {keep}.

errors.no_data_source: No data directory to back up. Set OCTOPUS_DATA_DIR (a directory on this machine), OCTOPUS_COMPOSE_FILE (the compose stack's file) or OCTOPUS_BACKUP_SOURCE=kubernetes.
errors.unknown_source: OCTOPUS_BACKUP_SOURCE must be host, compose or kubernetes, got '{source}'.
errors.compose_file_missing: The compose file '{file}' does not exist.
errors.data_dir_missing: The data directory {dir} does not exist. Nothing was backed up: point OCTOPUS_DATA_DIR at the directory that holds projects/ and task-attachments/.
errors.data_dir_unreadable: The data directory {dir} cannot be read by this user. Nothing was backed up; run it as the directory's owner, or as root.
errors.pvc_path: Could not find where PVC {pvc} (namespace {namespace}) keeps its files. Run this on the k3s node, or set OCTOPUS_DATA_DIR to the volume's directory.
errors.empty_dump: pg_dump wrote nothing, so no archive was made.
errors.remote_failed: Could not copy the backup to {remote}. The local archive {archive} is complete.
errors.status_not_written: Could not write {file}; Settings → Updates will not show this backup. The archive is complete.
